evidence_snippets: Modify clusters to meet Autopilot requirements You can use the Google Cloud console to check whether your Standard cluster meets all of the requirements to run workloads in Autopilot mode.
Modify an existing cluster In the Google Cloud console, go to the Kubernetes clusters page.
For example, you can't modify clusters to be VPC-native after cluster creation.
